sentences.text: A fix, from two or more good lines of position, is a small circle.
A dead reckoning position, from course and speed alone, is a half circle drawn on the course line.
An estimated position, a DR improved with other information such as current or a single line of position, is a small square.
An electronic fix, such as from GPS, is often shown as a triangle.
Write the time beside every position, followed by fix, D R or E P.
